commands.voidmaw.started: The ground cracks open beneath you — you are the Void Maw now, and everything above will be dragged into the depths. Right-click again to close it quietly; a special interaction can detonate the energy stored within the black hole!
commands.voidmaw.stopped: The maw seals shut, sated for now. Mass devoured: %s
commands.voidmaw.detonated: SINGULARITY COLLAPSE! The level %s maw unleashes everything it has consumed — blast power %s!
commands.voidmaw.levelup: The maw grows greedier — now level %s, with a pull radius of %s blocks!
commands.voidmaw.not_active: The maw lies dormant. Wake it with the Singularity Core.
commands.voidmaw.status_active: The maw is feeding: level %s · mass %s · radius %s blocks · collapse in %ss
commands.voidmaw.status_idle: All is quiet — no black hole stirs. Use the Singularity Core.
commands.voidmaw.already: The maw is already open beneath you. (right-click to close quietly)
commands.voidmaw.gift_received: A low hum fills your palm — the Singularity Core awaits. Right-click it to become the black hole; /voidmaw warehouse opens your abyssal storage.
hud.voidmaw.edit_hint: Drag to move · Scroll to resize · R resets · Esc to finish
